title: Deeper/broader consumer-route, release-artifact, and ACIS evidence revalidation
scope: Primary-source revalidation of FreeCAD DWG/DXF routes and current open-source ACIS reader/writer evidence; advisory qualification research only.

sources.observation: Stock DWG is external converter -> DXF -> selected importer. C++ and legacy Python importer feature lists differ; only the legacy list includes 3DFACE, neither documents MESH, and the guide says stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. CADExchanger is described as a separate 3D DWG route. The documentation repository was archived 2026-04-01, so documentation is route guidance, not a particular binary's runtime result.

Current convertToDxf() invokes the configured converter and calls communicate(), then treats existence of the expected output path as success without checking the child return code. This is a FreeCAD integration concern; qualification must capture status and independently inspect the fresh DXF.
Issue #1195 remains open; linked ACIS writer PR #1240 remains open and undeployed, depends on the ACDS/ACIS schema-storage work, and cannot be treated as released or independently accepted support.

On reported LibreDWG 0.14.8593 build 8a1ae764, a scratch-generated AC1032 DXF REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB loses the R2013+ AcDs payload while retaining the entity shell. It is build-specific peer evidence, not a current-master or libdxfrw result.

v0.6.2 is listed at short commit 7bcc952, released 2026-10-19, with published checksummed binaries. The Apple Silicon macOS archive SHA-256 is f5b56c71f6717a996656368a518a4e223999bc5d2258d8c3e72f050751db5134; the Windows x64 archive SHA-256 is bebea5db3e42ac125c22892de9c39030e0d553a18c07a53ac7e6b057b7880880.

The currently served codec and ASM crates are 0.6.1. The codec is a profile-limited bare SAT/SAB/SMT/SMB parser/neutral-geometry transfer route, not a DWG/DXF/AcDs reader or general-purpose ACIS kernel. The exact embedded crate versions/source used in the v0.6.2 release binary were not resolved.

decisions: Keep stock FreeCAD qualification limited to the exact selected converter/importer and explicit entity profile; ACIS semantic consumption by stock FreeCAD is not applicable.
Keep ACadSharp PR #1240 advisory until merged, released, and independently qualified.
Use LibreDWG #1411 only as a build-scoped scratch-generated carrier-loss shape; separate shell survival from AcDs payload and B-rep semantics.

Classify CADMPEG v0.6.2 as BINARY_ARTIFACT_PINNED / EMBEDDED_CODEC_UNBOUND / NOT_RUN until source and crate versions are matched. If run later, compare only exact owner-closed bare payloads and record all losses plus independent analytic expectations.
Do not create a new PAR finding or top-level subplan from these peer/source disclosures.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
